reason: All four pins and nine quotations match. The allowlist addition, approval branches, reviewer sequence, estimate, credential and minimal-live-charge corrections are grounded. The actual Q1 broadens the payment-data rule into a generic instruction to collect sensitive data with Terminal and omits the app-side prohibition on manually keyed payment values.
required_changes: Narrow Q1's 'use Terminal to collect sensitive data' to the documented payment collection rule: use the Terminal reader running the app to collect sensitive card and PIN information, and do not expose app UI for manual entry of PINs, authentication values, or payment information. Attribute it to all deployed apps regardless of review path. Old raw lines 14 and 34-38 and new raw lines 15 and 35-39 support the scope and prohibition. The distinction matters to a developer looking up whether they can implement a keyed card or PIN field in their app.

source_assessment_decisions.reason: The source-required update, Q2 and the reciprocal recommendation are supported. Restore the qualified reader-only collection and manual entry prohibition in the actual Q1.
